a.xlink:title: Aggregates the state, the link quality assessment and the statistics of one XBee link.
Connection state value with a connect/disconnect notification.
Primary template; only the function-signature specializations below are defined.
Computes link quality from the packet delivery ratio (PDR) and the RSSI link margin.
Runtime statistics: signal strength, transmit period and event counters.
Latest received signal strength, stored as an RSSI magnitude (-dBm), with a Digi percent conversion.
Transmit period measurement in scheduler ticks with smoothing and min/max capture.
Event counter saturating at MAX_VALUE, so it fits a fixed-width display field.
